answer: Make sybil farming unprofitable by forcing every identity to post a unique, bonded challenge answer before its votes or attestations count. Graders use a shared prism: score 0 if the text is copied or names no attacker-paid cost, so each fake burns its own writing time plus a slashable deposit. Kin-linked clones cannot inherit a sibling's passing mark, which leaves a sockpuppet swarm stranded like unprovisioned outposts on tundra. Only after K independent high scores does a crystal of spendable credit form around that exact address.
